lines.text: John sees a new heaven and a new earth, and God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.
An angel carries John to a high mountain and shows him the city with twelve gates bearing the names of Israel's tribes.
The angel measures the city with a golden rod, and each of the twelve gates is a single emerald.
John sees no temple in the city, and its gates are never shut, because there is no night there.
A river of the water of life flows from the throne of God, and the tree of life bears ten kinds of fruit.
